character_fit.label: Fitness proportions
character_fit.reason: Original straight-arm reach cannot clear the head.

timing.source: declared demonstration tempo; not measured from source photographs

overhead_range.method: Actual bilateral press joints and handles at the recorded phases and every intervening frame; authored fitted trajectory, not calibrated photo depth

overhead_profile.method: declared fitted shoulder-level press to stacked overhead lockout; constant limb lengths and bounded overhand grip; photo depth is uncalibrated

contacts.grip_source: declared fitted overhead-press grip; not calibrated from source photographs
contacts.grip_calibration: The overhead press uses a declared medium grip and full lockout; photo depth remains inferred.

rows.note: Reach adaptation changes the photographed equipment path.
Conservative shaft/body surface samples; overlap candidates need visual review.
Both handles must reach above the head; a secure grip alone does not establish the required movement range.
Both elbows must reach at least 175 degrees together at the recorded overhead lockout.
Both arms return to a bent lower press position.
The lower position must not overfold the elbows below 65 degrees.
The forearms point up to the grips throughout the press.
Both handles must complete a meaningful overhead stroke.
The wrists stack over the shoulders at lockout.
Both handles clear the actual top of the head at lockout.
The anatomical shoulder-to-hip torso stays upright rather than reclining through the press.
Both arms press together.
The supported or planted body stays stable during the press.
Feet must reach the floor.
Feet must reach the floor.
